title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Forest Hills Stadium, New York City | 2026
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at Forest Hills Stadium in Queens, New York City, USA, on 1 October 2026.

It was the fifth show of the 16th All-Starr Band’s fall tour of the USA, which lasted for nine dates in September and October 2026.

This was Starr’s first performance at Forest Hills Stadium since The Beatles performed there on 28 and 29 August 1964.

The 16th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Buck Johnson: vocals, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet

Concert setlist

  • ‘Matchbox’
  • It Don’t Come Easy
  • ‘Rosanna’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Pick Up The Pieces’ (Hamish Stuart)
  • ‘Down Under’ (Colin Hay)
  • ‘Boys’
  • ‘I’m The Greatest’
  • ‘Yellow Submarine’
  • ‘Cut The Cake’ (Hamish Stuart)
  • ‘Octopus’s Garden’
  • ‘No No Song’
  • ‘Choose Love’
  • ‘Overkill’ (Colin Hay)
  • ‘Africa’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Work To Do’ (Hamish Stuart)
  • ‘I Wanna Be Your Man’
  • ‘Who Can It Be Now?’ (Colin Hay)
  • ‘Hold The Line’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Photograph’
  • ‘Act Naturally’
  • ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’
  • ‘Give Peace A Chance’
